Facade renovation cost in India depends less on the panel and more on the building: its height, access, the condition of the wall, and how much of the old facade must come off. For metal recladding, Metaguise installed systems typically fall between INR 800 and INR 2,500 per sq ft, depending on system and complexity. Renovation projects often cost more per sq ft than new builds on easy sites, because of access, survey and making good, so treat any figure as a starting point and ask for a project quotation.
Key takeaways

• Repainting is cheaper today. Recladding usually wins when you count repaints over ten years or more. • The eight cost drivers are the same as for a new facade, but sub-frame condition and access weigh more in renovation. • A survey before pricing prevents surprises in the middle of the job. • Occupied buildings need a plan for noise, safety and working hours.
Repaint, repair or reclad?
Each option suits a different situation.

OptionUpfront costTypical intervalBest when
RepaintLowestPainted masonry needs repainting every 3 to 5 yearsWall is sound and budget is tight
Repair and refinishMediumDepends on repairLocalised damage
Recladding with metalHigherPowder-coated metal needs repainting every 8 to 15 years; PVDF metal needs annual cleaning for a 25-year design lifeLong-term owners who want a new look and less upkeep
The intervals above come from our guide to metal facade cost in India, which also explains why total lifetime cost often favours metal for owners who keep a property more than ten years.
What drives facade renovation cost
Metaguise uses eight variables when pricing a facade. In renovation, three of them need extra attention.

1. System complexity. Parametric and custom systems cost more than modular ones. 2. Panel size and format. 3. Finish specification. Special finishes cost more than standard PVDF colours. 4. Building height. Taller buildings need cradles or scaffolding, which add cost and time. 5. Site location and access. Tight lanes, no loading area or restricted working hours raise cost. 6. Total facade area. Under 500 sq ft carries higher proportional cost; above 3,000 sq ft gains scale. 7. Sub-frame and wall condition. An old wall with cracks, damp or uneven surfaces needs repair or a stronger bracket system. 8. Programme urgency. Faster schedules carry a premium.
The extra items in renovation

• Removal and disposal of old cladding, tiles, plaster or signage. • Waterproofing and crack repair before new cladding goes on. • Temporary protection for occupants, vehicles and pedestrians. • Survey and engineering of the existing structure, so the new load is safe.
Lightweight aluminium systems help because they add little load to an older frame. Our guide to retrofit facades explains how pre-engineered panels shorten on-site time.
A simple way to budget
Use a three-step approach.

1. Get a non-binding budget orientation from a facade company based on a short project description. Metaguise offers this before a formal quote. 2. Commission a survey of wall condition and access, so the quotation is based on facts. 3. Compare quotations line by line, using our facade company checklist, which advises treating a single lump sum as a red flag.
What a renovation quotation should list

Panel type, thickness, finish, sub-frame, fixings, sealants, scaffolding or cradles, transport, installation, taxes, removal of old material, waterproofing repairs, and the warranty terms. If an item is missing, ask whether it is excluded or forgotten.
Planning for an occupied building

For offices, hospitals, shops and apartment blocks, ask how the contractor will limit noise, protect people below, and phase the work so the building keeps operating. A phased plan often costs a little more but avoids shutting the building.
Does renovation cost vary by city?
Yes. Labour, access rules, local approvals, transport distance and market conditions differ across cities, from Delhi NCR to Hyderabad. Ask for a quotation based on your site, not a city average.
Frequently asked questions

1. What is the facade renovation cost per sq ft in India?

It varies widely. Metaguise installed metal systems typically fall between INR 800 and INR 2,500 per sq ft depending on system and complexity, and renovation extras such as removal, repair and access are added to the project.

2. Is recladding cheaper than repainting?

Repainting costs less today. Recladding with metal often costs less over ten years or more, because repainting cycles repeat.

3. Do I need to vacate the building during a facade renovation?

Not always. Many projects are phased so the building keeps operating. Ask your contractor for a work plan.

4. Can new cladding go over an old facade?

Often yes, on a new sub-frame, once the wall has been surveyed and repaired. The engineer decides based on load and condition.

5. How long does a facade renovation take?

It depends on area, access and complexity. Metaguise plans design, fabrication and installation as separate stages, and you should ask for a programme with milestones.

6. Will metal cladding help with heat?

A ventilated system with an air gap can help regulate temperature and moisture behind the cladding. Performance depends on the full system, including insulation.
